g.text: Pattern recognition: compare evidence, not silhouettes
Original sketches. NOT calibrated. Not patient ECGs. Do not measure rate or intervals here.
Sinus reference
Consistent P before each narrow QRS
Premature atrial beat
Early altered P; QRS may still be narrow
Multifocal atrial pattern
Changing P shapes; confirm rate separately
Atrial flutter
Organized repetitive atrial activity
Atrial fibrillation
No consistent P; irregular ventricular timing
Regular narrow tachycardia
Rapid regular complexes; P may be hidden
Junctional pattern
P absent or retrograde; QRS often narrow
Ventricular premature beat
Early broad beat; describe the surrounding rhythm
Monomorphic VT pattern
Repeated broad complexes of similar shape
Ventricular fibrillation
Chaotic pattern; true sustained VF has no pulse
Long-QT polymorphic VT / TdP
Changing amplitude and direction; urgent clinical response
Flat ventricular trace
Verify patient, contact, gain and another lead
Always integrate clinical pulse status, technical quality, multiple beats and the patient assessment.
